component.name: Inlark
component.summary: A considered home for your email

description.p: Inlark is a fast, keyboard-friendly email client for the accounts you already own. Connect directly to your JMAP or IMAP server, with no hosted service, subscription, or telemetry.

ul.li: Read conversations from several accounts in one unified inbox
Search, archive, organise, and write email with your keyboard or mouse
Keep drafts safe and undo everyday mailbox actions
Enjoy carefully designed dark and light appearances

description.p: Inlark is an early preview. Gmail and Microsoft OAuth sign-in are not yet supported.

screenshot.caption: A unified inbox with a clear identity for every account
